_comment: Source of truth for what the platform sells. Prices are placeholders in AUD cents; set real ones before `npm run stripe:sync`. `agent_slugs` must match src/agents/registry.ts.

offerings.name: Quote Triage
offerings.tagline: Turns a messy enquiry into a structured job spec, and says what it still needs to ask.
offerings.description: Paste an email, SMS or web-form enquiry. Get back a job type, urgency, location, access notes and a list of the questions you still have to ask before quoting. Missing information is a first-class output, not a guess.

offerings.name: Notes to Invoice
offerings.tagline: End-of-day job notes in, line-itemed draft invoice out.
offerings.description: Send the day's notes and your rates table. The agent maps work to rate lines and returns a draft invoice with quantities and rate references. It never does the arithmetic itself; totals are computed in code from the returned lines.

offerings.name: After-Hours Triage
offerings.tagline: Triages an 11pm message: gather what is missing, or escalate to a human now.
offerings.description: Classifies an out-of-hours message as emergency, urgent or routine. Gas leak, live wiring and water through a ceiling always escalate to a human immediately. Everything else gets the minimal follow-up questions needed to book it in the morning.

offerings.name: Trades AI Suite
offerings.tagline: All three agents, one subscription, one API key.
offerings.description: Quote Triage, Notes to Invoice and After-Hours Triage together with a shared monthly call allowance. The right choice for a business that wants to plug the whole enquiry-to-invoice path.

offerings.name: Salesforce Health Check
offerings.tagline: A written assessment of your org: security, automation, data quality, and what to fix first.
offerings.description: Two weeks. Read-only access to your org. You receive a prioritised findings report, a data-quality baseline, and a 90-day remediation plan. The same method used across the seven simulated engagements in the portfolio.

offerings.name: Service Cloud Quickstart
offerings.tagline: Cases, queues, entitlements and milestones, live in six weeks.
offerings.description: A fixed-scope implementation for a contact centre that needs SLAs it can measure. Case record types, assignment, entitlement processes, knowledge, and a deflection report defined before go-live rather than after.

offerings.name: Agentforce Pilot
offerings.tagline: Switch on the Agentforce licence you already pay for, with guardrails.
offerings.description: Six weeks from discovery to a countable pilot. Coverage and policy answers come from retrieved actions, never from the model. Every conversation has a human handoff that carries the transcript. Deflection is defined and reported before launch.

offerings.name: Fractional Salesforce Admin
offerings.tagline: A named administrator, two days a week, for businesses too small for a full-time hire.
offerings.description: Monthly retainer. User management, automation changes, reports and dashboards, release management, and a written monthly status with done, next, risks and decisions needed.

offerings.name: Advisory Hour
offerings.tagline: One hour on a call about your org, your data model, or your AI plan.
offerings.description: Book a single hour. Bring a problem. Leave with a written summary of what was discussed and what to do next.
